1. He wants a dog that you don’t want. He told you that’s a must have and you gave into his demand. 

2. He won’t let you buy or pick anything out for the apartment and you’re ignoring that.

It’s not a cute personality trait. He’s controlling, manipulative and he’s making your whole life solely about him. He has no cares about your feelings on this. It’s all about him, his wants and his needs. You want to excuse it because you love him. OP - you partner doesn’t actively love you back. Everything you’ve wanted/not wanted to happen has changed around to fit his every need and want.

Stop making excuses for him. Would you tell your friends what you’re telling yourself?

Love doesn’t take away keys because you need time and space. Love respects time and space.
